description_en: Retrieves the GPU cluster parameter list
name: GetGpuClusterArgsOptions

parameters.help_en:
Query the machine list of a cluster
Set the retrieval type to comm_instance_id_list or instance_id_list.
comm_instance_id_list: retrieves only the machines that participate in collective communication in the specified cluster.
instance_id_list: retrieves all machines in the specified cluster.

Query the AI task list of a cluster
Set the retrieval type to comm_task_id_list or task_id_list.
comm_task_id_list: retrieves only the tasks that involve collective communication in the specified cluster.
task_id_list: retrieves all tasks in the specified cluster.

Query the AI job pod list of a cluster
Set the retrieval type to comm_pod_list or pod_list.
comm_pod_list: retrieves only the pods that participate in collective communication in the specified cluster.
pod_list: retrieves all pods in the specified cluster.

Query the collective communication topology
communication: retrieves all communication group IDs.
channel: retrieves the channel list under the specified communication group ID.
topoType: retrieves the topology type under the specified channel of the specified communication group ID
parameters.help_zh:
1、查询集群机器列表场景
指定获取类型，设置为comm_instance_id_list或者
instance_id_list
comm_instance_id_list：只会获取指定集群中，有参与集合通信的机器列表
instance_id_list：是获取指定集群的所有机器列表

2、查询集群AI任务列表场景
指定获取类型，设置为comm_task_id_list或者
task_id_list
comm_task_id_list：只会获取指定集群中，有集合通信的任务列表
task_id_list：是获取指定集群的所有任务列表

3、查询集群AI作业pod列表
指定获取类型，设置为comm_pod_list或者
pod_list
comm_pod_list：只会获取指定集群中，有参与集合通信的pod列表
pod_list：是获取指定集群的所有pod列表

4、查询集合通信拓扑场景
communication：获取所有通信组ID
channel：获取指定通信组ID下的通道列表
topoType： 获取指定通信组ID下的指定通道下的拓扑类型
parameters.name: filter_type

parameters.help_en:
The filter conditions. The value is a JSON object. The cluster_id field is required. The following optional filter conditions are supported:
instance_id_list
comm_instance_id_list
pod_list
comm_pod_list
communication
task_id_list
comm_task_id_list
channel
topoType
parameters.help_zh:
过滤条件，json对象。“cluster_id”必须要包含，其他过了条件，支持如下：
instance_id_list
comm_instance_id_list
pod_list
comm_pod_list
communication
task_id_list
comm_task_id_list
channel
topoType
parameters.name: filter_values

code.description_en: The response code. Valid values: Success and Sysom.ServerError

data.description_en: The result of the parameter retrieval

message.description_en: The error message returned when the code is not Success
message.example: some error msg while fail，“” if success

total.description_en: The total number of returned entries
